'''Kara Safwan''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who worked as a [[spy]] for the criminal [[Rang Clan]]. In [[10 BBY]], she attended a party on board the ''[[First Light]]'', the [[yacht]] of [[Dryden Vos]], a [[crime lord]] of the [[Crimson Dawn]] syndicate which she had been hired to gather intel on. While on board, Vos's concierge [[Margo]] blocked her from entering the crime lord's inner circle. After the yacht arrived on the [[planet]] [[Vandor]], Safwan drank [[Vandor ice water]] with an [[Imperial officer]] on the viewing deck.

==Biography==
Kara Safwan was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who was hired by the criminal [[Rang Clan]] to [[spy]] and gather intel on the operations of the [[Crimson Dawn]], a rival criminal syndicate.<ref name="SoloOG" /> In [[10 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' dates the events on [[Vandor]] in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' to nine years after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the formation of the Empire to [[19 BBY]], therefore the event on Vandor in ''Solo'' must take place in [[10 BBY]].</ref> she attended a party on board the ''[[First Light]]'', the personal [[yacht]] of the Crimson Dawn [[crime lord]] [[Dryden Vos]].<ref name="SoloOG" />

She was on board when it arrived on the [[planet]] [[Vandor]] to collect a delivery of stolen [[coaxium]].<ref name="Solo" /> Safwan blended in well with the other revelers on board; however, Vos's concierge [[Margo]] suspected she was up to something and discreetly blocked her attempts to get deeper into the crime lord's inner circle.<ref name="SoloOG" /> During a performance by the [[Musician|singers]] [[Aurodia Ventafoli]] and [[Luleo Primoc]], Safwan stood with an [[Imperial officer]] on the yacht's viewing deck drinking<ref name="Solo" /> from a flask of [[Vandor ice water]] to keep her head clear.<ref name="SoloOG" /> After the performance ended, she and a brightly dressed human man then spoke with another pair of humans before passing by Vos himself after he descended from a raised area of the deck.<ref name="Solo" />

==Personality and traits==
Safwan had fair skin and [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s and [[hair]].<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Equipment==
While on the [[Starship|yacht]], Safwan wore a matching black and gold [[Clothing|dress]] and top. She also had a mid-cochlear recording device in her right [[ear]].<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kara Safwan first appeared in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''<ref name="Solo" /> and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="SoloOG" /> [[Lucasfilm]] employee<ref name="Lop">{{Visions|Lop & Ochō}}</ref> [[Kristen Hidalgo]] confirmed on [[Wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]] that the character was named by Pablo after [[Saf Davidson]], a host of several ''[[Star Wars]]'' podcasts.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|manraysky|status/1002040502898769921|[[Kristen Hidalgo]]|quote=I just asked Pablo. He named her after you, when you were staying with us.|archivefile=File:Kara_Safwan_name.png}}</ref>
